items.title: A sheaf with a representable surjective etale cover is an algebraic space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a sheaf F on (Sch/S)_{fppf} admitting a map U -> F from a scheme which is representable, surjective and etale is an algebraic space (source lines 1884-1891). The proof sets R = U x_F U, observes that R is a scheme with etale projections because U -> F is representable and etale, applies the presentation theorem to get F' = U/R with U -> F' surjective etale, and uses the canonical factorization U -> F' -> F together with the surjectivity criterion to conclude F' = F.
